findings.description: F-012: randrange(-GRANICA, GRANICA, RAZMER_SHAGA) is exclusive at the top, so the apple could never appear at +280 even though 19.9/19.19 present the legal set as symmetric and the snake may occupy +280.
findings.resolution: Changed to randrange(-GRANICA, GRANICA + RAZMER_SHAGA, RAZMER_SHAGA) in the 19.3 code block, and added a warning callout explaining that randrange's stop is exclusive and why the field would otherwise be asymmetric. The same change was applied to snake_basic.py and notebooks 19-03, 19-06 and 19-08. Verified: 20000 draws now span -280..280 with +280 reachable.
